test_cases.label: 1-arg functions: sin, cos, log, exp, fib, fac
test_cases.code:
v = {'ans': 0.0, 'E': m.e, 'PI': m.pi}
assert abs(statement(TokenizeWrapper('sin(PI)+1'), v) - 1.0) < 1e-6
assert abs(statement(TokenizeWrapper('log(E)'), v) - 1.0) < 1e-6
assert statement(TokenizeWrapper('fac(3)+fib(4)'), v) == 9
assert statement(TokenizeWrapper('fib(100)'), v) == 354224848179261915075

test_cases.label: n-arg functions: max, min, sum, mean
test_cases.code:

assert statement(TokenizeWrapper('mean(1, 2, 3)'), v) == 2.0
assert statement(TokenizeWrapper('max(1=x, 2+3, 4)'), v) == 5.0
assert statement(TokenizeWrapper('min(x, 4)'), v) == 1.0
